title: Visible suspicious sand and gravel
description: Adds a border top suspicious sand and gravel. So you can see them easily
body:
This literally adds borders to suspicous gravel and sand so you can distinguish them between normal sand and gravel 

![How it looks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12621fd1c152c15a8c479c2a39d529582a6d43b0.png)

**How to install**
Download the zip file and drop it into your resource pack folder in minecraft.
Then go to minecraft and enable the resrouce pack.
